complicacoes.texto: Doctor Light receives gratification from the humiliation and suffering of others, especially women and those who are not consenting to his Vontade.

Doctor Light’s Powers require ambient light, suffering a Weakness effect in reduced light exposure. The Gamemaster determines the effect’s graduação, as suits lighting levels. The Powers don’t work at all in Total darkness.
Doctor Light can be driven into a rage if sufficiently mocked, belittled, or if his immense self-doubt is otherwise enflamed.
